test_title: PYST 1: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 8 Aug 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Select the word which means the same as the group of words given.**

A large single detached house with a single or double storey
solution:
The correct answer is **Bungalow**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bungalow: **a large detached house with more than one storey.

 
 
• **Example: ***This house is in **bungalow **style and it is owned by a businessman. *
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct option which means the same as the group of given words is **option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Suite: **a set of rooms, especially in a hotel
 
• **Apartment: **a set of rooms rented for a holiday
 
• **Penthouse: **an expensive flat at the top of a tall building
